traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements for docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are implemented and verified:
- Core Functionality: The plugin exports a `plugin` default object with `rules` and `configs` populated from a central RULE_NAMES registry. Tests in tests/plugin-setup.test.ts and tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts confirm correct exports and structure. - Quality Standards & Metadata: src/index.ts defines a robust `pluginMeta` that reads from package.json with fallbacks, and attaches it to the plugin under `meta`. Tests assert that `meta.name`, `meta.version`, and `meta.namespace` match expectations. Developer docs for plugin development exist as specified. - ESLint v9 Flat Config Integration: The flat-config presets (recommended and strict) are implemented as arrays of config objects compatible with ESLint v9. Integration tests using FlatESLint (tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts) prove that both presets enable traceability rules when used as documented. - User Experience: README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provide concrete installation commands, flat-config examples, and guidance for using the recommended/strict presets, satisfying the UX and integration documentation criteria. - Error Handling: Rule-loading is wrapped in try/catch with console logging and a placeholder rule that reports a clear ESLint error, and this behavior is tested. CLI error handling is verified via an integration test that runs the real ESLint CLI and asserts non-zero exit and an appropriate error message. This aligns with REQ-ERROR-HANDLING and the Error Handling acceptance criterion. - Documentation: Internal dev guides for the plugin and custom rules exist and are referenced from the story. The project is structured as a TypeScript-based, publishable ESLint plugin with comprehensive tests, matching REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT, REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE, REQ-TYPESCRIPT, REQ-TEST-SETUP, and REQ-ERROR-HANDLING.
Given the passing targeted tests and the inspected implementation and documentation, the story is fully satisfied.
